task_summary: Implement the SimPO loss function in a trainer class and run a unit test to produce deterministic loss values saved to an npz file
decomposition_rationale: This is a focused task requiring implementing one function (simpo_loss) based on a well-documented formula, then running a test and saving results. The core knowledge is the SimPO loss math and its PyTorch implementation, plus environment setup. Two skills suffice: one for the loss implementation logic, one for environment/execution.

skills.name: evo-simpo-loss-implementation
skills.description: Implements the SimPO loss function following the paper's mathematical formulation. Covers the exact formula: L = -logsigmoid(beta * (chosen_avg_logps - rejected_avg_logps) - gamma) with label smoothing support, plus reward computation for logging.
skills.responsibility: Provide the correct SimPO loss function implementation including: pi_logratios computation, gamma/beta margin factoring, F.logsigmoid-based loss with label smoothing, hinge loss variant, and detached reward returns. Handles sigmoid and hinge loss types.
dr_sections: 5. Critical Implementation Details and Common Pitfalls

skills.name: evo-simpo-environment-execution
skills.description: Handles environment setup (Python 3.10, PyTorch, required packages), running the unit test, and saving loss results to npz format with correct keys.
skills.responsibility: Set up the Python environment with correct dependencies (torch, numpy, transformers, etc.), execute the unit test script, ensure loss tensor is properly detached/converted and saved to /root/loss.npz with key 'losses', and log Python version info.
dr_sections: 6. Saving PyTorch Tensor Results to NumPy (.npz)
4. Hugging Face TRL Class Structure and Configuration
